title: Small ordinary categories admit all small colimits
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$. Let $I$ be an ordinary category whose objects and arrows are $\mathcal U$-small sets, and let $F:I\to\mathrm{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$ be a strict diagram of ordinary categories whose objects and arrows are $\mathcal U$-small sets, with ordinary functors as morphisms. Then there exist a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category $C$ and functors $j_i:F(i)\to C$ constituting a colimit cocone in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The universal property concerns equality of functors, rather than equivalence of categories or natural isomorphism. The indexing category may be empty.
